text:
Got a gas leak at Rosetown station, found it at 0940 this morning. Sweet gas, approx. 24,000
m³ escaped. Looks like it's coming through the pipe body or maybe a weld-haven't
pinpointed it yet.
Contained inside the station fence. Shut down the line, venting to flare. Contractor crew's
here now, starting repairs. Will update when we know more.
Dave
Area Supervisor, Aspen Ridge
